Presets.CaveatsHeading: Where this preset differs from the setting:
Presets.PendingHolidays: Holiday notes are staged and will be created when you save.
Presets.Loaded: Loaded the {name} calendar into the editor.

harptos.Label: Forgotten Realms (Harptos)
harptos.Description: Twelve months of thirty days with five festival days between them, a ten-day tenday, and Selûne overhead. Dated 1495 DR.

Caveat.Shieldmeet: Shieldmeet falls only in leap years, which this module does not model, so it is not included.
Caveat.Tenday: The tenday runs continuously through the festival days instead of restarting each month, so a month does not always begin on the 1st.

golarion.Label: Pathfinder (Golarion)
golarion.Description: Absalom Reckoning: twelve months mirroring the real year, a seven-day week, and the moon Somal. Dated 4710 AR.

Caveat.LeapDay: Golarion’s leap day in Calistril is not modelled, so every year runs 365 days. Weekdays and moon phases are exact on 1 Abadius 4710 AR and drift a day every four years after that.

eberron.Label: Eberron (Galifar)
eberron.Description: Twelve months of twenty-eight days, a 336-day year that never drifts against its weekdays, twelve moons, and twenty-nine holidays. Dated 998 YK.

Caveat.MoonCycles: The twelve moons share a 28-day cycle staggered across the month, so every night shows a different sky. A 28-day cycle inside a 28-day month cannot also place each moon full in its own namesake month.
Caveat.ManyMoons: All twelve moons are drawn in the month grid. Switch any of them off in the moon list if the calendar looks crowded.

greyhawk.Label: Greyhawk (Common Year)
greyhawk.Description: Twelve months of twenty-eight days with four festival weeks, plus Luna and Celene. Dated 591 CY.

Caveat.Luna: Luna is full at Richfest alongside Celene. Its 28-day cycle cannot also reach full at the other three festivals, which stand 91 days apart.

darksun.Label: Dark Sun (Athas)
darksun.Description: Twelve months of thirty days with three five-day sun weeks, a six-day week, and the moons Ral and Guthay. Dated Free Year 1.

Caveat.YearNames: Athas names each year from a repeating cycle of seventy-six, such as Ral’s Fury. This module has no year names, so years are shown as numbers.

gregorian.Label: Gregorian (Earth)
gregorian.Description: The real-world calendar, with the Moon. Dated 1 January 2026.

Caveat.LeapDay: Leap days are not modelled, so every year runs 365 days. Weekdays and moon phases are exact on 1 January 2026 and drift a day every four years after that.
